question: How does the timing of the Battle of Garibpur relate to the formal India-Pakistan war of December 1971?

options.text: It was fought before the formal war began, while conventional pressure on the Jessore sector was already rising
It was fought after the formal war began, as part of the joint forces' advance
It had no connection to the war in the southwest

explanation: Garibpur came in November, before the formal war began on 3 December. It showed rising conventional pressure on the Jessore sector and bridged the guerrilla war and the December campaign.
